verdict.rationale: OpenHands' core product is an AI agent you delegate coding/ops tasks to via CLI, cloud, or automations — you type natural language tasks and get feedback, resume conversations, auto-approve actions, and trigger the agent from Slack/GitHub/Jira/schedules for bug triage, PR review, CI fixes, and security remediation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reports validating real-world reliability of these delegated workflows.
